notes: Literature check (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) could not run: the arXiv API returned HTTP 429 on both executed queries (one more query was refused by the self-exclusion filter for containing the method name), so all recommended references are marked [verify] and no similarity/novelty/scout output exists; the skill's fallback to 'off' worked but SKILL.md does not say how many retries to make on rate limiting. The self-exclusion filter refuses 'wavelet stereo matching' because it matches the method name 'Wavelet-Stereo', which makes concept-only queries awkward for papers whose method name is the concept. The EIC step says weights start at 1.0 and move only for verified reasons, but the pool-position consistency rule (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) pushed R3 to 66 to justify its Overall 4; the script then reports R3 composite 61.2 slightly above its pool band 55-61. Decision-table criterion 3 is ambiguous for Scene Flow (public-label test split, no validation split, no hidden-label server); I treated it as MAJOR because the main claim holds at every swept value. Phase 1 independence is only simulated in one context. Figures were unavailable, so Fig. 1 (the sole direct evidence for the central claim) could not be checked.
